title: PlannerSetupGate
description: The `data` payload of `GET /setup/{projectKey}[?issue=KEY-n]` on the backlog-planner: the gate Factory reads before starting a task. `open` is true once the setup task is done; until then `reason` is `setup-not-done`. A project with no setup task (handed over before the setup task existed) is never gated: `open` true, `reason`, `setupIssue` and `setup` null. `startable` is present only when `?issue=` was given: `{value:false, reason:setup-task}` for the setup task itself (never startable by an agent), `{value:false, reason:setup-not-done}` for any other issue while the gate is closed, otherwise `{value:true, reason:null}`.

projectKey.description: The project key asked about, upper-cased.

setupIssue.description: Readable id of the setup task, e.g. `APP-1`; null when no setup task is held.

setup.description: The `factory.handover-setup` object; null when no setup task is held.

startable.description: Whether the asked issue can start. `reason` is null when `value` is true, otherwise `setup-not-done` or `setup-task`.

setup.description: Identical to `factory.handover-setup` (a test keeps them equal).

name.description: Fixed task name; a constant so Factory, the planner and the dashboard agree on it.

localOnly.description: The owner's 'Local only' choice from the hand-over request, echoed.

steps.description: Ordered; at most one entry per step id.

updatedAt.description: When the setup object last changed.

id.description: Closed set: `app-repo` creates the app repository, `hexagon-repo` the hexagon repository, `onboard` onboards the app, `register-project` registers the project, `verify-discovery` checks the platform discovers it.

state.description: `skipped` is the state of `app-repo` and `hexagon-repo` when `localOnly` is true.

reason.description: Closed short code, present when `state` is `failed`.

detail.description: Free text for the reason; never a secret.

at.description: When this step last changed state.
